From the station to the gondola

From the train to the gondola, with or without equipment

Sinaia train station is down in town. The gondola is up the hill, 4 kilometres away, at the top of a climb through the Furnica district. There are three ways between them, and the time lost varies a lot.

The option we recommend

Stop at our centre, 3 minutes from the station. Get changed, gear up, leave your bags, and the taxi we call drops you at the base of the gondola. With a pass bought online, you walk straight in.

In the evening, coming down

Also by taxi, also around 30 lei. Take the number of the taxi you went up with and call it as you board the gondola to come down: when you reach the car park at the gondola base, the taxi is already waiting.

Frequently asked questions

Can I walk with skis on my back?
You can, but it's 4 kilometres uphill and you lose at least an hour. The taxi works out at 10 lei per person if there are three of you.
Isn't there a bus?
There is, but we don't recommend it in winter: it runs rarely and can get stuck at junctions or run late. For a ski day, time matters more than the price difference.
How do I get down in the evening?
By taxi, around 30 lei. Call the one you went up with as you board the gondola to come down, so it's waiting in the car park.

Stop at our centre, 3 minutes from the station.

We gear you up and call your taxi. Book the evening before so there's no wait at all.
